```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import os
import seaborn as sns
from seaborn import objects as so
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scvi
import harmonypy as hm

import anndata
```

```{python}
ref = sc.read("2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad")
sc.pl.umap(ref, color="labels")

sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(
    ref,
    n_top_genes=2000,
    batch_key="GEX_id",
    subset=True
)
```


```{python}
query = sc.read_h5ad("3_carpallcohort3_clustered.h5ad")

query = query[:, ref.var_names].copy()
```

```{python}
scvi.model.SCVI.setup_anndata(
    ref,
    layer="counts"
)
```

```{python}
model = scvi.model.SCVI(ref)
model.train()
```

```{python}
SCVI_LATENT_KEY = "X_scVI"

ref.obsm[SCVI_LATENT_KEY] = model.get_latent_representation()
sc.pp.neighbors(ref, use_rep=SCVI_LATENT_KEY)
sc.tl.leiden(ref)
sc.tl.umap(ref)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(ref,
    color="labels",
    frameon=False,
    ncols=1,
)
```

```{python}
scvi.model.SCVI.prepare_query_anndata(query, model)
```

```{python}
scvi_query = scvi.model.SCVI.load_query_data(
    query,
    model,
)
```

```{python}
scvi_query.train(max_epochs=200, plan_kwargs={"weight_decay": 0.0})
query.obsm[SCVI_LATENT_KEY] = scvi_query.get_latent_representation()
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(query, use_rep=SCVI_LATENT_KEY)
sc.tl.leiden(query)
sc.tl.umap(query)
```

```{python}
sc.pl.umap(query,
    color="Patient",
    frameon=False,
    ncols=1,
)
```

```{python}
full = anndata.concat([query, ref])
full
```

```{python}
full.obsm[SCVI_LATENT_KEY] = scvi_query.get_latent_representation(full)
```

```{python}
sc.pp.neighbors(full, use_rep=SCVI_LATENT_KEY)
sc.tl.leiden(full)
sc.tl.umap(full)
```
